_about: PARKED. Wave 3 of ../m0-rich.md: the ping-pong rally, its ender, the return class and the shared flight paths. Not loaded, not hashed. Strike data comes from strikes.antihero.wave1.json.

paths._about: ONE definition of a flight path, for Encounter (the rush op's path), Camera (framing) and VFX (trails). A path is P(s) for s from 0 to 1, from S (where the mover is) to I (where it must arrive). d = I - S by the shortest arc; D = |d|. The sim owns the position; render and camera read the same function. No draw anywhere in it.

ease._note: a hard launch-off and a brake into the arrival. On the spiral the speed is 1.73 D/T at the start, 1.24 D/T at half time and 0 on arrival.

spiral.n: a unit vector perpendicular to d in the path's plane; sigma is +1 or -1: the pole is on n's side for +1, and the curve bulges on the other side

properties._units: lengths in D; angles off the chord. The whole curve lies between the perpendiculars at S and at I, on the side opposite the pole.

shallower.path: P(s) = C + phi^(s*a/90) * Rot(sigma*a*s) * (S - C), with C = S - d / (phi^(a/90) * Rot(sigma*a) - 1)

side: bulge away from the struck body's path: the pole goes on the side of the body's mid-flight point
if the body flies within 0.05 D of the chord, flip the side from the last bounce; the first side is one keyed draw (blitz/side, the exchange index)
plane: up or down, or into a neighbouring depth lane (ADR 0009)
a depth-lane bulge when the body's path is level; up when within 4 bh of the ground
clearance: sample 8 points; none under the ground plus 0.5 bh, none inside a structure
else the other side, then another plane, then 60 degrees, then 30
else no intercept: an ordinary pursuit, and the blitz goes to its ender or ends

arc.h: the smaller of 0.25*D and 4 bh (300 u)
arc.w: a unit vector perpendicular to d in the path's plane: up by default

properties._note: at h = 0.25 D. Past 1,200 u the apex stays 300 u, so the arc flattens: 1.04 D and 26.6 degrees at 2,400 u

ground.path: P(s) = (x along the shortest arc from S to I, the ground height at x plus the body's ground offset)
ground._note: a run, then a slide over the last 30% of the distance; it follows the terrain, so it is defined by the heightfield, not by a formula

event.name: path
event.when: emitted when the move is planned, before the first tick of travel
event._use: Camera frames the chord plus the widest offset on the bulge side before he leaves. VFX draws the trail by sampling P(s(t)) between ticks: at 65 u a tick a polyline through tick positions shows corners.

rally._returnBlows: the last one is the ender; the cap is by mood and tier (Calm 2; Tense 2, 3, 3, 4; Frenzied 3, 4, 5, 5 for tiers 1 to 4)

ticksFromTheKnock._note: leave is the hit-stop. From leaving to a middle contact is Game Design's 30 ticks (24 in Frenzied): 24 (18) of travel on the spiral and the 6 of anticipation, standing loaded. PROPOSAL for Game Design: the ender keeps the same travel and adds its whole 18-tick wind-up in place, so its bounce is 12 ticks longer. Squeezing the wind-up into the 30 would leave 12 ticks of travel (6 in Frenzied).

rally.interceptPoint: I = B(contact) + offset * v: the struck body's predicted position on the contact tick, pushed along its direction of travel by the return blow's own contact distance (wave 1), so he waits just beyond where it arrives, facing it
rally.decisive: the whole rally is one decisive exchange, decided at the ender
limits: bounces stay in the lane and never pass through buildings; only the ender may be a targeted smash
it never starts from another blitz's ender
the turning throw is never a return blow or the ender (moveset-rules.md 11(d))

returnClass.perfectBlock: the whole 6-tick anticipation is the window, with no early tolerance; it works in the air
returnClass.repeat: no return blow twice in one rally
returnClass.data: profiles.dynamic.strikeClass.classes gains 'return'; the perfect-block window is per class: return 6, against 10 for the others

newPose.look: At the end of the curve he brakes side-on, already turned to face the body that is still coming, the striking limb loaded and his weight on the back leg.
newPose._legal: Combat's proposal: flight only, he is drawn the whole way; and at each return blow he is on screen for the 6 anticipation ticks and at least 4 after contact, so the rally is never shock rings with no fighter in them

returns.look: He is already there, side-on and still; the blade hand meets the body's own speed and he barely moves.
The flat arc catches the body as it passes his shoulder and swings it onto a new line.
He arrives half turned away and unfolds the arm into the body's path.
The body arrives almost on top of him; the elbow lifts it up the way it came.
The leg is a level line the body runs onto; his arms balance the other way.
A whip of the shin across the body as it arrives, his hips barely turning.
He does not turn at all: the tail meets the body behind his hip.

patterns.knocks: back and forth along one line, 10 degrees off it into the lane each way
patterns.ender: across: a long launch, or the targeted smash at a brunt target

patterns.knocks: a zigzag that climbs: each knock 30 degrees above the line back
patterns.where: near the ground or over a city: it clears the roofs
patterns.ender: down: the drive, or the crater slam under its gates

patterns.knocks: each knock turns about 70 degrees, so the body circles a point
patterns.where: over a landmark or a field of formations: the camera holds one frame
patterns.ender: down onto the point, or across away from it

answers.when: any time before the ender lands
answers.plays: both are pushed apart and tumble free; no winner

answers.answer: perfect block on a return blow
answers.when: a middle blow's 6 anticipation ticks; the last 10 of the ender's 18
answers.plays: he staggers; the defender's riposte launches, and the defender may start a rally of his own at once

answers.when: between the knock's hit-stop and the next anticipation: ticks 4 to 28
answers.plays: the body slips the intercept; he arrives, strikes air and over-commits (Animation's over-commit pose)
each return does guard damage only; the heavy ender is a GUARD BREAK
